name: ops-digest
description: Daily operator digest: read-only reasoning over our own trading data to surface regime shifts, config drift, and execution anomalies. Analytics only — never places or adjusts trades; every suggestion requires explicit operator approval.

points.name: Calibration drift
points.description: Is model_prob_yes still well-calibrated against realized settlement outcomes, per city, vs the rolling 45-day baseline?

sub_points.name: Brier score, recent vs prior window

points.name: Regime detection
points.description: Has forecast error or trading edge shifted meaningfully per city, recent window vs prior?

points.name: Execution anomalies
points.description: Fill rate vs expectation, spread/cross regime, signs of adverse selection.

points.name: Config drift
points.description: Is a live city's realized performance diverging from the profile committed in its decision doc?

points.name: Data health
points.description: Is ingestion current (forecasts, observations, price snapshots) and does the account-equity reconciliation tie out?
